youtube_title: Jesus... I Can't Afford The Ticket Home This Year 🚆 | Philippians 4:19 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

Trains are full and flight fares cost three months of his savings, so he can't afford to go home for Diwali and is ashamed to tell his Amma.

He: Jesus... trains are full and flight tickets cost three months of my savings. 🚆
He: Waitlist 84. I stopped checking. Amma already asked which day I'm coming.
Jesus: You're not failing home by staying. Home is people, not a berth.
He: But she'll say don't waste money, and it'll sound like pity.
Jesus: That's her love talking. Call her anyway. Let the video call be your seat at the table this year.
Jesus: Show up in the ways you can. Presence isn't only travel.

“And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.”
Philippians 4:19 (BSB)

Show up in the ways you can. Presence isn't only travel.

💬 What would you do with one free trip home? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
